'''Docking Bay 22''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kailor V]]. The [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] [[Bink Kitik|Bink]] and [[Tavia Kitik]] used the hangar for their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] sometime in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] during on an operation.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
